system.description:
7 charges. Aim it at a target and roll d10: 1 Slow (target), 2 Sleep (target and one ally within 10ft), 3 Lightning Bolt, 4 Stinking Cloud, 5 Invisibility (target), 6 Cure Light Wounds (target), 7 Haste (target), 8 Confusion (15ft burst on the target), 9 harmless (the target is covered in flowers or turns blue for 1d4 hours), 10 Fireball (centred on the target). Spells are cast as a 5th-level caster, Fortitude, Reflex or Will as the spell says, DC 12.

Rarity: Rare
